description: Four distinct readable RPG icons in a precise two by two sheet, each icon fills its own 32 by 32 cell. Top left: clenched fist coated in polished black metal with silver glints. Top right: eye with a glowing crimson iris and perception rings. Bottom left: fragmented crown with black and crimson lightning. Bottom right: closed indigo book bound in silver with a luminous violet clasp. Bold single-color black outlines, low detail, limited navy crimson silver violet palette, dark miniature backgrounds, crisp pixel art, no text, no grid lines or frames.
